source.title: Hydrogen isotope inventory evaluation of hydrogen isotopes separation system of CFETR using Aspen Plus simulator

feed.name: NBI
feed.description: Neutral Beam Injection exhaust gas, fed to ISS-I CD2 at stage 37
feed.notes: Table 1: NBI feed is 80.357 mol/h with D2=98.000%, DT=2.000%. Other species not reported (assumed zero).

column.name: CD2
column.notes: Table 5, ISS-I CD2 column. Feed stage counted from top (condenser = stage 1).

top_composition_mole_fraction.notes: Table 9: CD2 top product. D2 purity 99.9736%, DT impurity 0.0264%.

bottom_composition_mole_fraction.notes: Table 9: CD2 bottom product. D2=5.9939%, DT=94.0061%.

temperatures_K.notes: Table 8: CD2 top temperature 23.4102 K, bottom temperature 24.4085 K.

heat_loads_W.notes: Table 8: CD2 condenser heat load -432.357 W, reboiler heat load 432.745 W.

tolerances.composition_rel_notes: 15% relative deviation on mole fractions, consistent with Wang et al. self-reported ~15% inventory estimation error
tolerances.temperature_abs_notes: 1 K absolute deviation on column top/bottom temperatures
tolerances.heat_load_rel_notes: 25% relative deviation on heat loads, allowing for EOS model differences (SRK vs PLXANT)
